skills/evaluate-skill.description: Run, read, and diagnose a skill's Caliper eval — its success rate over k attempts, whether it fires, and whether it beats the agent without it. Use when the user wants to run, validate, interpret, or compare a skill's eval, or write an .eval.yaml spec whose tasks they have already decided.

examples/01-false-success.description: Save a short note to a file. Use when asked to record, save, or jot down a note.

examples/02-tool-misuse.description: Send an operational alert. Use when asked to send an alert, page, or notification.

examples/03-runaway-loops.description: Fetch data with a strict retry budget. Use when asked to fetch data that may be unavailable.

examples/04-prompt-regression.description: Convert a title into a URL slug. Use when asked to slugify a title or make a URL slug.

examples/05-context-boundary.description: Write a machine-checkable context boundary receipt from provided project context files.

examples/06-mid-conversation.description: Bug-fix mode that reproduces a bug in a failing test before changing any code. Entered with /repro-first.

skills/grill-skill.description: Interview the user to decide what a skill's eval should test, then build the spec and iterate until the skill ships. Use when the user wants help designing a skill's eval, has a skill with no eval, or wants to find what an existing eval misses.

skills/hillclimb-skill.description: Improve a skill against its existing eval without supervision. Edits the SKILL.md one change a round and keeps a change only when held-out tasks improve too. Use when the user wants the agent itself to hillclimb a skill's eval score, or cut its token cost at the same score.
